name: Gurezi Walnut
note: Walnuts in the shell, from trees around the village.
story: Cracked fresh, they taste sweeter than shelled nuts that have sat for months.
uses: Keep in a cool, dry place
why: Walnuts are one of the few nuts with plant omega-3s, and they bring protein, magnesium and vitamin E along with them. A few a day is plenty.
